# Provenance

These files are the OpenUI Lang 1.0 conformance fixtures, copied unchanged from
[thesysdev/openui](https://github.com/thesysdev/openui) at commit
`8d9c4c3b108a7b5352192a6a9d7327bdf7ea19b5`, directory `spec/fixtures/1.0/`.
They are licensed under the MIT license in [LICENSE](LICENSE), copied from the
root of that repository.

Do not edit them. To update, copy the directory from a newer upstream commit,
update the commit above, and rerun `cargo test --test conformance`.
